lesson.title: What Makes a Capstone Project Different
lesson.subject: ela

contentBlocks.text: Last week you built media/AI literacy skills. This week: planning your own independent literature capstone project!

A capstone project is different from a regular assignment: it's self-directed (you choose the focus), sustained (built over weeks, not days), and independent (you're responsible for your own planning and pacing, not just following step-by-step instructions). This combines two of this course's threads — independent literature study and the capstone research project — into one real, extended piece of work. Explain why a project requiring self-directed planning over several weeks demands different skills than a single-day assignment.
You just reviewed what makes a capstone project genuinely different! Tomorrow we'll start choosing your own literary text.

objectives: Understand a capstone project as self-directed, sustained, and independent
Explain why self-directed, multi-week work demands different skills than a single-day assignment
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review last week's media/AI-literacy work briefly.
2. Introduce the capstone project's self-directed, sustained, independent nature.
3. Have the child explain why this demands different skills.
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's text-choosing lesson.
differentiationTips: Struggling: contrast one familiar single-day assignment directly against the capstone's multi-week scope to make the difference concrete
Ready for more: ask the child what personal habits (time management, self-motivation) they think will matter most for a project like this
Opens this week's capstone-planning thread, combining the course's own independent-literature-study and capstone-research-project threads into one sequence
teacherGuide.answerKey: A self-directed, multi-week project requires planning ahead, pacing your own work over time without daily reminders, and staying motivated through a longer effort — these are genuinely different skills than completing a single clearly-defined assignment in one sitting, closer to real independent research or professional work.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Directly addresses this course's capstone-research-project thread from its own description, opening it with a genre-definition lesson before the planning steps in the days ahead.
